ThreatRelationship.description: Both scenarios cross from unauthenticated HTTP input into application or host execution authority, affecting the host execution context.
ThreatRelationship.modelingEffect: They are kept distinct because /lookup reaches os.popen through command construction, while /evaluate reaches Python eval directly.

ThreatRelationship.description: Both involve server-side interpretation of request-controlled text inside the Python/Flask process.
ThreatRelationship.modelingEffect: They are not duplicates because eval and Jinja rendering have different entry points, interpreters, preconditions, and reachable object models.

ThreatRelationship.description: Both may expose server-side resources or secret-bearing data through parser/decryption behavior before ordinary response rendering.
ThreatRelationship.modelingEffect: The scenarios differ in mechanism: XML parser resource handling versus chosen-ciphertext decryption behavior.

ThreatRelationship.description: SQL manipulation impact depends heavily on the database backend and privileges selected at startup.
ThreatRelationship.modelingEffect: T009 captures the deployment-dependent authority that can amplify T007 beyond the default in-memory SQLite training context.

ThreatRelationship.description: JWT and config threats both depend on cryptographic material and correctness of cryptographic use, but affect different security objectives.
ThreatRelationship.modelingEffect: The scenarios remain separate because T008 targets token integrity while T005 targets decryption oracle behavior over config keys.

ThreatRelationship.description: Both threats rely on browser-controlled cookies crossing into server-side trust decisions.
ThreatRelationship.modelingEffect: They are distinct because value cookie processing invokes pickle deserialization, while authentication cookie processing invokes JWT verification.

ThreatRelationship.description: Command-execution impact is strongly affected by whether the service is exposed beyond localhost and by the host privileges of the running process.
ThreatRelationship.modelingEffect: T009 records the operational preconditions that determine the reachability and blast radius of T002.
